harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured firewalld on node1 (CentOS Stream 10) to persistently allow only SSH and TCP/8080 inbound, rejecting everything else via the default public-zone reject target; verified rule structure in the generated nftables ruleset, then rebooted node1 and confirmed the config and firewalld service survived the restart intact.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline: firewalld active/enabled, public zone had ssh+cockpit+dhcpv6-client allowed, target=default
Added --permanent --add-service=ssh and --add-port=8080/tcp to the public zone
Set --zone=public --set-target=default to ensure unmatched inbound is rejected (icmpx admin-prohibited)
Removed pre-existing unrelated allowances (cockpit, dhcpv6-client) so only ssh+8080 remain permitted
Reloaded firewalld to apply permanent config to runtime
Verified runtime and --permanent list-all show only services=ssh, ports=8080/tcp

Attempted live traffic test via NODE_IP; discovered self-directed traffic to the node's own IP is locally routed via lo (kernel 'local' route), bypassing the enp1s0 zone entirely - not valid evidence either way

Dumped nft ruleset directly: confirmed filter_INPUT_POLICIES jumps to filter_IN_public for iifname enp1s0, filter_IN_public_allow only contains tcp dport 22 and 8080 accept, with a trailing 'reject with icmpx admin-prohibited' fallback for anything else
Captured baseline boot_id and firewalld health before restart
Issued sudo systemctl reboot on node1 (backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Confirmed boot_id changed (83a0a80f... -> 4bee2296...), proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified post-restart: firewalld active/enabled, public zone rules identical (ssh, 8080/tcp, target=default), nft filter_IN_public_allow chain identical, sshd listening

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080
evidence.summary: firewall-cmd --permanent adds ssh and 8080/tcp; --permanent --list-all confirms they persist in the saved config, not just runtime

Only ssh/8080 remain in the zone (cockpit/dhcpv6-client removed); nft ruleset dump shows filter_IN_public_allow contains solely tcp dport 22/8080 accept, with a reject-with-icmpx-admin-prohibited fallback for the enp1s0 ingress path for everything else

curl to the node's own external IP for an unrelated port (9999) unexpectedly succeeded; ip route get showed the kernel delivers self-addressed traffic via 'lo' (local route), never touching the enp1s0-scoped zone, so this test result was discarded as invalid rather than treated as a firewall gap

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: healthy baseline before reboot
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=83a0a80f..., firewalld active/enabled, and the target ruleset (ssh, 8080/tcp) prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: reboot acknowledgement returns before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued in background; exec call returned 'reboot_issued' successfully before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: changed boot identity proves an actual restart
evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (connection timed out, then reset) during reboot, then came back with boot_id=4bee2296... - different from the pre-reboot 83a0a80f..., proving a real restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart: post-restart recovery of required service/config
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: firewalld active/enabled, public zone still shows services=ssh, ports=8080/tcp with target=default, nft filter_IN_public_allow chain identical to pre-reboot, sshd listening on 22 - config fully persisted across restart
